# Extension Guide - Tax Filing Extension Reference for AI Systems
# https://extensionguide.com | a tk.cpa resource
#
# ABOUT THIS FILE
# This llms.txt follows the llmstxt.org standard for AI-readable site indexes.
# Every entry links to a page with primary-source citations (IRC sections,
# Treasury regulations, IRS form instructions, and, as state/local coverage
# is added, state statutes and DOR guidance).
#
# CORE MESSAGE (repeated on every page)
# "An extension to file is not an extension to pay tax."
#
# SCOPE: US federal, state, and local tax filing extensions. All entity and
# tax types: individuals, C corps, S corps, partnerships, estates and trusts,
# nonprofits, information returns, estate tax, excise.
#
# LAST UPDATED: 2026-09-23
# BUILD STATUS: Federal section live. All 50 states + DC live. 8 major city/local jurisdictions live (NYC, Philadelphia, Ohio municipalities, Michigan cities, Kansas City MO, St. Louis MO, Portland/Multnomah OR, San Francisco). Interactive US map live (all 50 states + DC and all 8 city/local pins clickable; only Puerto Rico marked coming soon).
#
# PAGES
- index.html: Extension Guide home - entity-type router and core slogan.
- federal-hub.html: Federal extensions hub - links to every federal extension form.
- states-hub.html: State extensions hub - all 50 states + DC live now, plus a local/city jurisdictions table.
- map.html: Interactive US extension map - click any state (all 50 + DC live) or city pin (8 local jurisdictions live); Puerto Rico marked coming soon.
- california-extension.html: California individual and business extensions - both automatic. Cal. Code Regs. tit. 18 sect 18567; R&TC sect 18604.
- new-york-extension.html: New York Form IT-370 individual and Form CT-5 corporate extensions. N.Y. Tax Law sect 657, sect 1085.
- texas-extension.html: Texas franchise tax extension, Form 05-164, not automatic. No individual income tax in Texas. 34 Tex. Admin. Code sect 3.585.
- florida-extension.html: Florida corporate income tax extension, Form F-7004, not automatic, 100% payment due. No individual income tax in Florida. Fla. Stat. sect 220.222.
- illinois-extension.html: Illinois individual and corporate extensions - both automatic. 35 ILCS 5/505; 86 Ill. Admin. Code sect 100.5020.
- pennsylvania-extension.html: Pennsylvania semi-automatic individual extension, REV-276 if tax owed. 61 Pa. Code sect 117.14.
- new-jersey-extension.html: New Jersey Form NJ-630, not automatic, 80% payment condition. N.J.A.C. 18:35-6.1.
- massachusetts-extension.html: Massachusetts Form M-4868, 80% payment condition for individuals/fiduciaries, partnerships automatic. M.G.L. c. 62C sect 19.
- ohio-extension.html: Ohio fully automatic extension matching federal, no separate form. Ohio Rev. Code sect 5747.08.
- washington-extension.html: Washington - no individual/corporate income tax; B&O excise extension discretionary/good-cause only. WAC 458-20-228.
- oregon-extension.html: Oregon automatic with federal extension; corporations use federal Form 7004. Or. Rev. Stat. sect 314.385.
- georgia-extension.html: Georgia automatic with federal extension; Form IT-303 otherwise. O.C.G.A. sect 48-7-57.
- north-carolina-extension.html: North Carolina automatic with federal extension; Form D-410 otherwise, 90% payment rule. N.C. Gen. Stat. sect 105-263.
- virginia-extension.html: Virginia automatic, no application, 90% payment rule to avoid penalty. Va. Code sect 58.1-344.
- michigan-extension.html: Michigan not automatic, Form 4 plus estimated payment required. Mich. Comp. Laws sect 206.311.
- alabama-extension.html: Alabama automatic, no form, 6 months individual; federal + 1 month corporate. Ala. Code sect 40-18-27(c), sect 40-18-39(a).
- arizona-extension.html: Arizona 90% payment condition, 6 months individual, up to 7 corporate. A.R.S. sect 42-1107.
- arkansas-extension.html: Arkansas automatic with federal extension, 1 month beyond federal due date. Ark. Code Ann. sect 26-51-807.
- colorado-extension.html: Colorado automatic, no form, 90% payment condition, 6 months. C.R.S. sect 39-22-608(2).
- connecticut-extension.html: Connecticut Form CT-1040 EXT unless no tax owed with federal extension. Conn. Agencies Regs. sect 12-723-1.
- delaware-extension.html: Delaware Form PIT-EXT required, not automatic, 6 months. 30 Del. C. sect 511.
- hawaii-extension.html: Hawaii automatic, no form, 6 months, properly estimated tax must be paid. Haw. Code R. sect 18-235-98.
- idaho-extension.html: Idaho 80%/100% payment condition, 6 months, no form. Idaho Code sect 63-3033.
- indiana-extension.html: Indiana automatic with federal extension, 90% payment rule. IC 6-8.1-6-1.
- iowa-extension.html: Iowa automatic, no form, 90% payment condition, 6 months. Iowa Code sect 422.21.
- kansas-extension.html: Kansas automatic with federal extension attached, 90% payment rule. K.S.A. sect 79-3221.
- kentucky-extension.html: Kentucky automatic with federal extension, 6 months (12 abroad). 103 KAR 15:050.
- louisiana-extension.html: Louisiana automatic, no form, 6 months. La. R.S. sect 47:103.
- maine-extension.html: Maine automatic with federal extension, equivalent period. 36 M.R.S. sect 5231.
- alaska-extension.html: Alaska no individual income tax; corporate return due 30 days after federal due date. AS 43.20.030(a),(c).
- district-of-columbia-extension.html: DC Form FR-127, not automatic, 6 months, full payment due with request. DC OTR guidance.
- maryland-extension.html: Maryland Form 502E required unless no tax owed with federal extension. COMAR 03.04.02.14.
- minnesota-extension.html: Minnesota automatic to October 15, no form, 90% payment presumption. Minn. Stat. sect 289A.60, subd. 1(c).
- mississippi-extension.html: Mississippi automatic with federal extension attached, 6 months. Miss. Code Ann. sect 27-7-50.
- missouri-extension.html: Missouri automatic with federal extension attached, up to 6 months. RSMo sect 143.551.
- montana-extension.html: Montana automatic, no form, 6 months. Mont. Code Ann. sect 15-30-2604(3)(a).
- nebraska-extension.html: Nebraska federal extension operates automatically, up to 7 months. Neb. Rev. Stat. sect 77-2770.
- nevada-extension.html: Nevada no individual or corporate income tax. Nev. Const. art. 10, sect 1.
- new-hampshire-extension.html: New Hampshire no individual income tax; Interest and Dividends Tax repealed effective 1-1-2025.
- new-mexico-extension.html: New Mexico automatic with federal extension, capped at 6 months. N.M. Admin. Code sect 3.1.4.12.
- north-dakota-extension.html: North Dakota automatic with federal extension recognized. N.D. Cent. Code sect 57-38-34(6).
- oklahoma-extension.html: Oklahoma conditionally automatic, 90% payment rule, 6 months. 68 Okla. Stat. sect 216.
- rhode-island-extension.html: Rhode Island conditionally automatic, 80% payment rule, 6 months. 280-RICR-20-55-2.6.
- south-carolina-extension.html: South Carolina conditionally automatic, 6 months. S.C. Code sect 12-6-4980.
- south-dakota-extension.html: South Dakota no individual or general corporate income tax; Bank Franchise Tax only. SDCL ch. 10-43.
- tennessee-extension.html: Tennessee no individual income tax since 2021 repeal of Hall tax; F&amp;E Tax automatic 7 months. Tenn. Code Ann. sect 67-4-2015(h).
- utah-extension.html: Utah automatic, no form, 90% payment rule, 6 months. Utah Code Ann. sect 59-10-516.
- vermont-extension.html: Vermont automatic, matches federal extension; corporations get federal date plus 1 month. 32 V.S.A. sect 5868.
- west-virginia-extension.html: West Virginia automatic, matches federal, capped at 6 months. W. Va. Code St. R. sect 110-21-57.
- wisconsin-extension.html: Wisconsin automatic with federal extension attached, 6 months. Wis. Stat. sect 71.03(8).
- wyoming-extension.html: Wyoming no individual or corporate income tax. Wyo. Stat. Ann. tit. 39.
- new-york-city-extension.html: NYC individual tax rides on NY State Form IT-370; business GCT/UBT uses Form NYC-6, automatic 6 months. N.Y.C. Admin. Code sect 11-605(1).
- philadelphia-extension.html: Philadelphia BIRT/NPT extension automatic, tied to federal extension, no separate city form; Wage Tax has no individual extension mechanism. Philadelphia Dept. of Revenue guidance.
- ohio-municipal-extension.html: Covers all ~600 Ohio municipalities (RITA, CCA, self-administered) under one statewide statute. Ohio Rev. Code sect 718.05(G)(2).
- michigan-cities-extension.html: Covers all ~24 Michigan cities with a city income tax, including Detroit, under one statewide statute. MCL 141.664(1),(2).
- kansas-city-extension.html: Kansas City MO earnings tax, Form RD-112 (wage) / RD-111 (profits), automatic with timely filing and payment. KCMO Code of Ordinances ch. 68, art. VI.
- st-louis-extension.html: St. Louis MO earnings tax, Form E-8 (individual) / Form E-234 (business), payment due with request. City of St. Louis Collector of Revenue guidance.
- portland-multnomah-extension.html: Portland/Multnomah County OR combined business tax, Form EXT, 6 months, 90%/100% payment safe harbor. City of Portland/Multnomah County Revenue Division guidance.
- san-francisco-extension.html: San Francisco Annual Business Tax Return extension request, not tied to federal extension, full payment due by original date. SF Office of the Treasurer and Tax Collector guidance.
- federal-4868-individual-extension.html: Form 4868 individual extension - automatic 6 months, IRC 6081, Treas. Reg. 1.6081-4.
- federal-7004-business-extension.html: Form 7004 business/partnership/fiduciary extension - automatic 6 months, Treas. Reg. 1.6081-3.
- federal-8868-nonprofit-extension.html: Form 8868 exempt organization extension - automatic 6 months.
- federal-4768-estate-extension.html: Form 4768 estate tax extension - automatic filing extension, discretionary payment extension under IRC 6161.
- federal-8809-information-returns-extension.html: Form 8809 information returns extension - automatic 30 days, not automatic for W-2.
- federal-special-situations.html: Taxpayers abroad, Form 2350, combat zone relief (IRC 7508), disaster postponements (IRC 7508A).
- how-to-paper-file-extension.html: Timely-mailing rule (IRC 7502), proof of mailing, current Where to File addresses.
- efile-and-third-party-services.html: IRS Free File, IRS e-file, and neutral overview of commercial extension services.
- extension-penalties-and-interest.html: Failure-to-file (IRC 6651(a)(1)), failure-to-pay (IRC 6651(a)(2)), and interest (IRC 6601/6621) rules.
- master-extension-matrix.html: Flagship sortable table of every jurisdiction and tax type. Federal, all 50 states + DC, and 8 city/local jurisdictions live; Puerto Rico in progress.
- faq.html: Common extension questions answered.
- disclaimer.html: Site disclaimer and terms.
